content: Parameters: We tune the parameters of each model with the following search space (bold indicate the choice for our final model): character embeddings dimension: {25, 50, 100, 150, 200, 300}, word embeddings size: {25, 50, 100, 150, 200, 300}, LSTM hidden states: {25, 50, 100, 150, 200, 300}, and INLINEFORM0 dimension: {25, 50, 100, 150, 200, 300}. We optimize the parameters with Adagrad BIBREF28 with batch size 10, learning rate 0.02, epsilon INLINEFORM1 , and decay 0.0.
